sentences.text: OUTrading Marine Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-25 under the industry code 46890, other specialised wholesale.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-08-28.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a marine word but the registered industry is wholesale trade and the record shows no ocean use.
